judul: Transformasi Lanskap Kecerdasan Artifisial: Analisis Paradoks Produktivitas, Adopsi Lintas Sektor, dan Tata Kelola Berkelanjutan
judul_en: Transforming the Artificial Intelligence Landscape: Productivity Paradox, Cross-Sector Adoption, and Sustainable Governance
deskripsi: Kajian komprehensif mengupas Paradoks Solow dalam adopsi AI, transformasi lintas sektor (kesehatan, rekayasa software, pendidikan, kreatif), restrukturisasi pasar tenaga kerja dua jalur, kepatuhan etika regulasi SE Menkominfo No. 9/2023, hingga metodologi rekayasa instruksi RTF modular.
deskripsi_en: A comprehensive scholarly analysis dissecting the modern Solow Productivity Paradox in enterprise AI adoption, cross-sector transformations, labor market restructuring, ethical regulatory frameworks (SE Menkominfo No. 9/2023), and modular RTF prompt engineering methodologies.
author: Khohar Muhamad Fatahurrohman

judul: Adopsi Small Language Models (SLMs) di Sektor Perbankan: Arsitektur On-Premise, Kedaulatan Data UU PDP, dan Efisiensi Finansial
judul_en: Adoption of Small Language Models (SLMs) in Banking: On-Premise Architecture, Data Sovereignty, and Financial Efficiency
deskripsi: Kajian arsitektur Small Language Models (SLMs) on-premise di sektor perbankan: efisiensi biaya hingga 90%, jaminan kedaulatan data nasabah UU PDP No. 27/2022, paradigma The Models Pyramid, dan kepatuhan Panduan Tata Kelola AI OJK 2025.
deskripsi_en: Architecture study on on-premise Small Language Models (SLMs) in banking: cutting Opex by up to 90%, strict client data sovereignty under PDP Law, the Models Pyramid paradigm, and OJK 2025/2026 governance compliance.
author: Khohar Rohman

judul: Model Context Protocol (MCP) dan Arsitektur Multi-Agent AI: Transformasi Standar Integrasi Konteks dan Tata Kelola Korporat
judul_en: Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Multi-Agent AI Architecture: Standardizing Context Integration and Enterprise Governance
deskripsi: Panduan arsitektur Model Context Protocol (MCP) dan Multi-Agent Systems enterprise: memecahkan krisis integrasi N x M, eliminasi kerentanan Text-to-SQL, lapisan kendali Control Plane RBAC, dan audit kepatuhan regulasi AI 2026.
deskripsi_en: Architectural guide to Model Context Protocol (MCP) and enterprise Multi-Agent Systems: resolving the NxM integration bottleneck, eliminating raw Text-to-SQL risks, enterprise Control Plane with RBAC, and AI governance auditability.
author: Khohar Rohman

judul: AI Agent dalam Manajemen Rantai Pasok dan Logistik: Arsitektur Self-Healing, Mitigasi Bullwhip Effect, dan Tata Kelola Proporsional
judul_en: AI Agents in Supply Chain Management and Logistics: Self-Healing Architecture, Bullwhip Mitigation, and Proportional Governance
deskripsi: Panduan implementasi AI Agent dan Multi-Agent Systems di manajemen rantai pasok: arsitektur self-healing, mitigasi agent bullwhip effect via konsensus multi-agen, proyeksi pasar Gartner 2026-2030, dan piramida tata kelola proporsional.
deskripsi_en: Implementation guide for AI Agents and Multi-Agent Systems in SCM: self-healing supply chains, multi-agent consensus protocols against agent bullwhip distortion, Gartner 2026-2030 forecasts, and proportional governance tiers.
author: Khohar Rohman

judul: AI Agent dalam Cybersecurity dan SOC Enterprise: Mitigasi Alert Fatigue, Prinsip Least Agency Privilege, dan Kepatuhan Regulasi
judul_en: AI Agents in Enterprise Cybersecurity & SOC: Mitigating Alert Fatigue, Least Agency Privilege, and Regulatory Compliance
deskripsi: Kajian arsitektur AI Agent dalam Security Operations Center (SOC) enterprise: menyaring 70-85% alert fatigue, korelasi multi-tahap SIEM/EDR, doktrin keamanan Least Agency Privilege, dan pemenuhan batas notifikasi 3x24 jam UU PDP No. 27/2022.
deskripsi_en: Architectural study on AI Agents in enterprise Security Operations Centers (SOC): filtering 70-85% false positive alert fatigue, multi-stage telemetry correlation, Least Agency Privilege security doctrine, and meeting PDP Law 3x24h incident notification limits.
author: Khohar Rohman

judul: AI Software Engineering Agents dalam Transformasi SDLC: Dari Copilot ke Autonomous Engineer, SWE-bench, dan Verification-First
judul_en: AI Software Engineering Agents in SDLC Transformation: From Copilot to Autonomous Engineer, SWE-bench, and Verification-First
deskripsi: Kajian mendalam AI Software Engineering (SWE) Agents dalam siklus hidup pengembangan perangkat lunak (SDLC): tolok ukur SWE-bench, arsitektur multi-berkas asinkron, mitigasi governance debt, dan proyeksi produktivitas Gartner 2028.
deskripsi_en: In-depth study of AI Software Engineering (SWE) Agents across the modern SDLC: SWE-bench verified benchmarks, asynchronous multi-file coding workflows, mitigating governance debt, and Gartner 2028 productivity forecasts.
author: Khohar Rohman

judul: Manajemen Talenta Berbasis AI: Efisiensi dan Etika, Strategi Talent Remix, Mitigasi Bias Algoritma, dan UU PDP
judul_en: AI-Driven Talent Management: Efficiency and Ethics, Talent Remix Strategy, Mitigating Algorithmic Bias, and PDP Law
deskripsi: Kajian arsitektur AI dalam manajemen talenta dan HR enterprise: transisi ke Dynamic Skills Intelligence, strategi Talent Remix Gartner 2026 melampaui PHK massal, audit bias disparitas dampak, dan perlindungan hak pelamar UU PDP No. 27/2022.
deskripsi_en: Architectural analysis of AI in enterprise talent management and HR: transition to Dynamic Skills Intelligence, Gartner 2026 Talent Remix workforce amplification, algorithmic disparate impact audits, and PDP Law applicant rights.
author: Khohar Rohman
